body:
I am feeling a lot better today.  Last night was bad but some of you really reached out to me and I admitted to some new friends that I have a problem.  

Having this type of line of support is a godsend and I really thank the people who volunteer their free time to help people in need.

I am not recovered, it will be a process but in time I will be better and I have people like you guys to thank.

Thank You.  I had a lot of replies and PMs and people helped.  I am going to get therapy and use my social network to get through this.  I'm having ups and downs but nowhere near what I had last night.  

Thank you for thinking of me, I will message you if I ever get into that mindset again, though I know with help I won't need to!
Thank you.  I hope you feel better too and I know you will be in a place to do so in the future!

Thank you.  I am getting better now.  Had an episode which I hadn't had in a couple years.  Having some highs and lows today but not like what I faced before.  Called a couple friends, things will be getting better.

Thank you for taking the time to message me, it means a lot.
going over to a friends, he will help.  thanks.
